summary: Set `AAP_TEMP_POSTGRES` to the temp pod name, `oc cp` `artifact.tar` and `artifact.tar.sha256` into `/tmp/aap-temp-pvc/`, read the controller, hub and gateway database credentials and admin password by base64-decoding the `aap-*-postgres-configuration` secrets, then `oc exec -it deployment.apps/aap-temp-postgres -- /bin/bash`.
questions: How do I get AAP database passwords on OpenShift?
How do I copy the migration artifact into a pod?

answer_card.title: Copy artifact and read DB secrets
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
export AAP_TEMP_POSTGRES=$(oc get pods --no-headers -o custom-columns="metadata.name" | grep aap-temp-postgres)
oc cp artifact.tar $AAP_TEMP_POSTGRES:/tmp/aap-temp-pvc/
oc cp artifact.tar.sha256 $AAP_TEMP_POSTGRES:/tmp/aap-temp-pvc/
oc get secrets aap-controller-postgres-configuration -o jsonpath="{.data['password']}" | base64 -d
oc get secrets aap-gateway-postgres-configuration -o jsonpath="{.data['postgres_admin_password']}" | base64 -d
oc exec -it deployment.apps/aap-temp-postgres -- /bin/bash
```
